# FunOutdoors

> > FunOutdoors is an outdoor adventure resource featuring expert gear reviews, guides, and tips for skiing, camping, biking, and hiking enthusiasts.

Founded by outdoor experts including Scott Meldrum, Neil Beckett, Tom Fortune, and others, FunOutdoors provides comprehensive content covering destinations from the French Alps to the Blue Ridge Mountains. Operated by Interactive Ventures, Inc. in Long Beach, California.

## Key Topics

- Outdoor gear reviews
- Skiing and snow sports
- Camping tips and locations
- Biking guides
- Hiking and adventure guides
- Scott Meldrum (Founder/Editor)
- Neil Beckett (Contributor)
- French Alps
- Blue Ridge Mountains
- Ski safety
- Outdoor recreation
- Slope locations
- Wilderness camping
- Adventure sports content

## Getting Started

- [Homepage - FunOutdoors](https://funoutdoors.com): Main landing page for outdoor adventure tips, guides & gear reviews
- [About Us - FunOutdoors](https://funoutdoors.com/about): Team intro featuring Scott Meldrum, Neil Beckett & outdoor experts

## Outdoor Activity Guides

- [Skiing Category Page - FunOutdoors](https://funoutdoors.com/skiing): Skiing hub with gear reviews, safety tips & slope locations
- [Camping Category Page - FunOutdoors](https://funoutdoors.com/camping): Camping hub covering gear, tips & locations from parks to wilderness
- [Biking Category Page - FunOutdoors](https://funoutdoors.com/biking): Biking hub with gear reviews, tips & riding locations for all levels
